kind: pooled machines running a model none of them could hold
one_line: Eight households pool GPUs and RAM; the model spans the mesh, and so does the cost of somebody closing a laptop.
insider_rationale: holds the two machines the layers actually sit on
monitor_rationale: reports layer placement and eviction; four months, then we look again

ladder.label: residency-notice
ladder.text: A machine leaving the mesh gives an hour's notice before its layers go.

shared.label: pooled-buys
shared.text: Hardware bought out of the pot is agreed before it is bought.

access.label: invited-in
access.text: You join because somebody already here vouched for you, and that is the whole of the trust model.

inner_a.label: weights-pinned
inner_a.text: A model's weights are pinned to a digest, and the digest is what people talk about.

inner_b.label: weights-two-copies
inner_b.text: Every layer lives on at least two machines before it is served.

clash_a.label: nobody-idles
clash_a.text: A machine in the mesh is available to the mesh, not held back for its owner.

clash_b.label: own-machine-first
clash_b.text: Your own work on your own machine comes before the mesh's.

extra.label: node-names
extra.text: A node is named for its household, not for its hardware.

policy.root: We decide by consent: one reasoned objection stops a thing, and saying nothing is not an objection. Changing something we have called a principle takes the mesh, and anything we cannot undo is not decided by silence.
policy.inner: Whoever holds the machines the layers sit on decides the weights.
policy.unheld: Billing is decided by whoever holds it.
policy.ladder: The first time we ask. The second time the mesh asks together. The third time the answer is no.
policy.inner_amended: Two of us have to object before a weights change stops.

inner_proposal.text: pin the mesh to the new 70B digest and drop the old one
inner_proposal.because: two pinned digests is two answers to what `primary` means

inner_objection: the old digest is what every household's scripts name, and dropping it breaks them the same evening

unheld_proposal.text: split the electricity cost by measured GPU-hours

monitor_watch.because: the node held four layers with no second copy and left without notice
monitor_watch.dismissal: these two do not really conflict

ladder_subject.first: shut the laptop at the end of the day without an hour's notice
ladder_subject.second: take the desktop off for a reinstall without an hour's notice
ladder_subject.third: pull the big machine off during a run without an hour's notice
ladder_subject.because: layers on a machine that vanishes are layers the mesh has to re-place mid-request
ladder_subject.ruling_1: it was a battery going flat and we left it there
ladder_subject.ruling_2: the mesh agreed one more, then no more

other_subject.about: serving a second model at once
other_subject.text: hold a second model resident alongside the primary one

clash.text: let a household take its machine's whole GPU for a two-day fine-tune
clash.because_a: a machine held back for its owner is a machine the mesh planned around and does not have
clash.because_b: a mesh you cannot use your own hardware in is a mesh people leave
clash.carried: the mesh is small enough to reroute two days of layers and large enough that nobody would stay if it could not; revisit when a fourth household joins

amend_convention.text: name nodes for their GPU so placement decisions read at a glance
amend_convention.because: the household name says nothing about what will fit on it

amend_principle.text: let a household mark its machine reserved for a stated window
amend_principle.because: a stated window is something the placement can plan around, which an unannounced withdrawal is not

irreversible.text: delete the old digest from every machine to free the disk

silence.about: how much of your machine you owe the mesh
silence.rationale: every share anybody proposed was either unenforceable or the reason somebody would leave, and the informal answer has held for a year
silence.proposal: set a minimum share of each machine that the mesh may always use

panel.rationale: three people to look at the residency rule for a month
